comments.content: `finalCommands` already contains the rendered interpreter and before-commands via `ScriptService.scriptCommands`, but only `commands` is replaced here. The original `interpreter` and `beforeCommands` remain set, so `TaskRunner.renderCommands()` prepends them again when the real runner starts (for example, `sh -c ...` becomes `sh -c sh -c ...`). Clear those two properties after composing, or defer composition so each component is included exactly once.
